A LITTLE PREPARATION HELPS

Before you come in.

  • Confirm the service, timing, and fees with the clinic team.
  • Ask whether your test or scan needs specific preparation.
  • Bring your referral, previous reports, and current prescriptions, if you have them.
  • Discuss your results and next steps with your doctor.

Availability and preparation vary by service. Our team can guide you before your visit.
